blocks.text: Biostatistics science ki woh shaakh (discipline) hai jo statistics ke tareeqe khaas taur par biology, medicine (tib) aur sehat (health) ke data par lagati hai. Is mein data ko jama karna (collection), pesh karna (presentation), us ka analysis (jaanch parakh) aur interpretation (matlab nikalna) shamil hai, taa ke kaam ke nataij nikal sakein. Biostatistical analysis se researchers aur sehat ke mahireen poori population (aabadi) ko test kiye baghair, sirf sample (chhote hisse) ke data se poori population ke baare mein soch samajh kar faisle kar sakte hain; poori population ko test karna aksar mushkil ya mehnga hota hai. Maslan kisi population ke workers ka aik representative (numainda) hissa parh kar biostatistics andaza laga sakti hai ke tamam workers mein koi bimari kitni aam hai (prevalence).

blocks.prompt: Researchers poori population ke bajaye sample kyun parhte hain?
blocks.explanation: Poori population ko test karna aksar mushkil ya bohat mehnga hota hai. Agar sample poori population ka sahih numainda (representative) ho to us ke data se poori population ki khasiyaton ka achha andaza lag jata hai.

items: Biostatistics: biology, medicine aur sehat ke data par statistics ke tareeqe.
Data jama karna, pesh karna, analysis aur interpretation is ke kaam hain.
Sample data se poori population ke baare mein faisle kiye jate hain.
